_doc_stages: Available stages: newcomer, awakened, explorer, scholar, warden, champion, master
_doc_priority: CraftTweaker scripts override these settings. CRT takes priority.
_doc_format: Map resource IDs to required stage names. Keys starting with _ are comments and ignored.

items._comment: Item gating: players below required stage cannot craft/use these items.

enchantments._comment: Enchantment gating: hidden from enchanting table/anvil until required stage.

dimensions._comment: Dimension gating: portal travel blocked until required stage. Keys are dimension IDs.
dimensions._doc_ids: 0=Overworld, -1=Nether, 1=End. Modded dimensions have their own IDs.

entities._comment: Entity gating: entities do not spawn until required stage.

biomes._comment: Biome gating: players warned/blocked from entering biomes until required stage.
